svg.title: Single-life learning paradigm diagram
svg.desc: Inventory: three left single-life experience photo cards with ellipses; three horizontal rows of person icons, individual data cylinders D1-D3, arrows, single-life model parameter boxes theta*, dashed arrows, and rounded single-life representation boxes containing simple geometric object arrangements. A dashed curly grouping brace connects the three representations to a gray question callout and a rounded explanatory callout. Symmetry basis: the three learning rows are vertically equipartitioned with aligned columns for experience, model, and representation.

g.desc: Three stacked source-experience cards; each has a gray card frame, a constructed image thumbnail, and an ellipsis indicating additional samples.
Origin for row 1 is the person icon; content proceeds rightward to D1, theta star 1, and a representation box.
Second row repeats the learning pipeline aligned with row 1; D2 and theta2 use lavender coloring and the representation shape arrangement is different.
Third row repeats the pipeline with peach coloring; D3 and theta3 align to the common model column and end in a third representation.
A dashed brace visually groups the three representation frames and points to the questions at right.
Gray question box listing two evaluation questions for the learned single-life models.
Rounded explanatory callout defining the single-life learning paradigm.
